name: pi-GAN
definition: A generative adversarial approach to unsupervised 3D representation learning from 2D images. It conditions an implicit radiance field represented by a SIREN network on a noise vector z to produce a 5D spatio-angular radiance field, which is rendered via volume rendering to synthesize view-consistent images.
summary: pi-GAN is a generative adversarial network for unsupervised 3D representation learning from 2D images, distinguished by its use of periodic sine activations and FiLM conditioning to synthesize view-consistent images via volume rendering.
